en: A black‑and‑white, slightly grainy photograph of a modernist high‑rise concrete building shot from a low angle. The façade shows vertical slit windows and a long band of small windows near the ground floor. Large Hebrew letters, made of dark material, are mounted high on the wall, indicating the function of the building. The style and framing resemble a vintage architectural postcard.
